title: Define word-list licensing and source policy
context: Record which word lists and clue sources Crosswords may use, under what terms,

spec.summary: Define word-list licensing and source policy
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Every source has an entry in `docs/data-sources.md`.
Redistribution is marked yes, no, or conditional.
Training use is marked yes, no, or conditional.
Unclear terms default to no redistribution.
A source can be disabled without breaking the build.
Add a source check to CI.
A missing source row fails the check.
